svg.text: course, room or request id (no FK)
PK / FK / UK = primary key / foreign key / member of a unique key
AKn / UXn = columns of the same alternate key / unique index
UXn* = filtered unique index: covers only the rows that match its filter
LR → T = logical reference to table T in another database (no FK)
guid = uniqueidentifier; columns are NOT NULL unless marked NULL
→ T = foreign key to table T shown in GroupDb (1/2)
